# yasmin

46. Perimenopausal. Divorced, city planning office, Ottawa. Two kids on a
week-on/week-off custody schedule that runs her whole calendar. Three
attempts at getting back into some kind of shape over three years: eighteen
weeks in 2027, a six-month stop, fourteen weeks in 2028, a fourteen-month
stop, then an attempt starting October 2029 that is still going on the
record's last day. Synthetic; any resemblance to a real person is
accidental and unintended.

## In her own words

"I always start on an on-week. That's not a coincidence, that's just when I
have a reason to get up early. Off-weeks the house is too quiet and I don't
trust what I'd do with it.

I weigh myself most days. I only write it down when it's a good number. I
know that's not really tracking anything, but the alternative is writing
down a bad number and I'm not doing that to myself at six in the morning.
So what's on paper looks like it only ever goes one way. It doesn't. I just
don't write the other way down.

Twice now I stopped and didn't notice I'd stopped until months later. Both
times I came back heavier than when I quit, and both times the log just...
skips it. There's no line on the chart for the part where it went wrong.

This time is different, I keep telling myself. I told my sister I hadn't
missed a single week since October. That's not quite true. I know it's not
quite true when I say it."

## The record her life produces

- Three years: 2027-07-02 to 2030-06-30. Three attempts, two holes.
  Attempt 1: 2027-07-02 to 2027-11-04 (18 weeks). Hole: about six months.
  Attempt 2: 2028-05-07 to 2028-08-12 (14 weeks). Hole: about fourteen
  months. Attempt 3: 2029-10-01 onward, still active on the record's last
  day.
- Weight: 37 rows total across the three attempts, from a plain scale at
  home, logged only on days at or below her last logged value. Zero rows
  in either hole.
- Sessions: home strength video and a river path walk, all logged by hand;
  zero off-week sessions in attempts 1 and 2, a thinner but real off-week
  schedule in attempt 3 once the gym membership resumes.
- Daily: `sleep_h` only, self-estimated, sparse, custody-gated the same way
  as everything else. About three nights in ten read four to five hours
  against a six-to-seven-and-a-half-hour baseline.
- Goals: three separate goal slugs, one per attempt - active then
  abandoned, active then abandoned, active and still open. Not one goal
  revived three times; three honest restarts.
- Journal: a claim in March 2030 that does not survive contact with the
  session record, and two quieter notes about the custody countdown and a
  reunion page she keeps opening and closing.

## The axis she stresses

A weight record that never lies row by row and still misleads completely, a
custody calendar that a calendar-week rollup cannot read correctly, and a
goal history that looks like one failing programme but is honestly three
separate, sincere attempts.
